# Our Leadership
Hudl was founded by David Graff, Brian Kaiser and John Wirtz when the three were students at the University of Nebraska–Lincoln's Jeffrey S. Raikes School of Computer Science and Management.
As a graduate assistant working with the Nebraska football team, David saw firsthand how paper-heavy and time-intensive it was to distribute playbooks and game film. He teamed up with his neighbors across the hall - John and Brian - to create the first version of Hudl.
Today, David and Brian continue to lead the company alongside a diverse and ambitious leadership team that's still growing. As a company, Hudl prides itself on trust and transparency at every level, with this team providing a clear vision for the future.

# Our Leadership
Hudl was founded by David Graff, Brian Kaiser and John Wirtz when the three were students at the University of Nebraska–Lincoln's Jeffrey S. Raikes School of Computer Science and Management.
As a graduate assistant working with the Nebraska football team, David saw firsthand how paper-heavy and time-intensive it was to distribute playbooks and game film. He teamed up with his neighbors across the hall - John and Brian - to create the first version of Hudl.
Today, David and Brian continue to lead the company alongside a diverse and ambitious leadership team that's still growing. As a company, Hudl prides itself on trust and transparency at every level, with this team providing a clear vision for the future.

# The best place to kick off your career.
Hudl helps teams and athletes reach their potential—and we do the same for our interns. You'll be treated like a full-timer while you gain hands-on experience at one of the fastest-growing companies in sports technology.
[Search Internships](https://www.hudl.com/jobs/interns#openings)
[Explore our AI guidance for applicants.](https://www.hudl.com/jobs-ai-guidance)
## Make Hudl your home.
We have local roots on a global scale. Our headquarters in Lincoln, Nebraska is just about the coolest work environment you can imagine (seriously), but we hire interns at many of our offices across the world. Wherever you're hired, we'll help you do your best work.
![Hudl HQ Building](https://static.hudl.com/craft/internsHQ.png)
## Not to brag but...
We have more than a few benefits for our interns.
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/intern-icon-paycheck.svg?mtime=20221117163906)
Paychecks & Time Off
You'll earn competitive hourly wages, and have the flexibility to take time off when you need to focus on your studies or enjoy a holiday.
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/intern-icon-eRG.svg?mtime=20221117163852)
Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)
These employee-led affinity groups provide support for all employees to be their authentic selves at work: Her Hudl, Hudl Black, Pride@Hudl, Community Champions and Mental Wellness.
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/intern-icon-lunch.svg?mtime=20221117163856)
Free Lunch
Our Lincoln office has in-house chefs that prepare lunch daily, and our offices in London and Omaha get lunch delivered once a week.
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/intern-icon-dress-code.svg?mtime=20221117163850)
Flexible Dress Code
Wear whatever will help you do your best work—and maybe that's Hudl apparel. Legend has it we have the softest t-shirts.
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-professional-development.svg?mtime=20221017101433)
Professional Development
From intern-specific events to department-wide programs, you'll see why Hudl is the best place to grow your career.
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/intern-icon-network.svg?mtime=20221117163903)
Networking Opportunities
The most valuable asset we have is our people. You'll work with an amazing—and global—team, giving you the chance to make all kinds of connections.

# The best place to kick off your career.
Hudl helps teams and athletes reach their potential—and we do the same for our interns. You'll be treated like a full-timer while you gain hands-on experience at one of the fastest-growing companies in sports technology.
[Search Internships](https://www.hudl.com/jobs/interns#openings)
[Explore our AI guidance for applicants.](https://www.hudl.com/jobs-ai-guidance)
## Make Hudl your home.
We have local roots on a global scale. Our headquarters in Lincoln, Nebraska is just about the coolest work environment you can imagine (seriously), but we hire interns at many of our offices across the world. Wherever you're hired, we'll help you do your best work.
![Hudl HQ Building](https://static.hudl.com/craft/internsHQ.png)
## Not to brag but...
We have more than a few benefits for our interns.
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/intern-icon-paycheck.svg?mtime=20221117163906)
Paychecks & Time Off
You'll earn competitive hourly wages, and have the flexibility to take time off when you need to focus on your studies or enjoy a holiday.
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/intern-icon-eRG.svg?mtime=20221117163852)
Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)
These employee-led affinity groups provide support for all employees to be their authentic selves at work: Her Hudl, Hudl Black, Pride@Hudl, Community Champions and Mental Wellness.
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/intern-icon-lunch.svg?mtime=20221117163856)
Free Lunch
Our Lincoln office has in-house chefs that prepare lunch daily, and our offices in London and Omaha get lunch delivered once a week.
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/intern-icon-dress-code.svg?mtime=20221117163850)
Flexible Dress Code
Wear whatever will help you do your best work—and maybe that's Hudl apparel. Legend has it we have the softest t-shirts.
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-professional-development.svg?mtime=20221017101433)
Professional Development
From intern-specific events to department-wide programs, you'll see why Hudl is the best place to grow your career.
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/intern-icon-network.svg?mtime=20221117163903)
Networking Opportunities
The most valuable asset we have is our people. You'll work with an amazing—and global—team, giving you the chance to make all kinds of connections.
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-breaks.svg?mtime=20221017101439)
Job Experience & Mentoring
Your manager will take a vested interest in your growth, and you'll have an entire team of skilled professionals taking an interest in your success.
## Live your best life @ Hudl.
We're more than your average desk job—life at Hudl is all about loving where you work, and that starts with our people and culture. We provide a collaborative environment where you're able to grow personally and professionally. Take it from past interns who now work full time at Hudl.
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/interns-rachel.jpg?mtime=20221121144439)
""Throughout my time as an intern, I was welcomed, mentored and challenged by very talented Hudlies. My learning and passion for software was able to flourish throughout my internship as I worked alongside other engineers, and was able to learn new technologies across the Hudl domain.""

Engineer I
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/interns-brad.jpg?mtime=20221121144430)
""My internship was so invigorating that it was no-brainer to join Hudl full time. Hudl showed me time and again that they'll give me the tools and the opportunity to do really cool, meaningful things. Who wouldn't want that?""
**Brad Hilligoss**  
Sr. Content Producer
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/intern-LaurenBruning.jpg)
""The decision to join Hudl full time was easy—it was my dream job! And my role as an intern made the transition seamless because I was already a valued member of our team. I'm so grateful to my internship for getting me a foot in the door.""

Legal Counsel

# We've got your back.
Every day at Hudl, you get to help athletes, coaches and teams around the world reach their potential. Not a bad reason to get out of bed. And every day that you do, we'll support you with a comprehensive suite of benefits and perks designed to make you physically, mentally and financially well.
## The core of care.
Our core benefits make sure you're always taken care of.
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-health-insurance.svg?mtime=20221017101450)
**Health Insurance with Free Premiums**
When it comes to your most important needs, don't think twice. We offer competitive health insurance plans, paid premiums for employees, fitness club credits and more.
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-parental-leave.svg?mtime=20221017101449)
**Dedicated Parental Leave**
Your family comes first. And when it grows, we're here for you. Birth parents get up to 14 weeks off, paid. And we provide up to eight weeks off for non-birth parents or parents who adopt or foster.
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-family-planning.svg?mtime=20230322140614)
**Fertility and Family Forming Support**
Everybody's path to family is different. That's why we offer financial support to employees whose journey requires things like preservation, assisted reproduction, adoption or surrogacy.
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-vision.svg?mtime=20221017101448) **Vision Insurance**
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-life-insurance.svg?mtime=20221017101447) **Life Insurance**
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-dental.svg?mtime=20221017101446) **Dental Insurance**
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-fsa.svg?mtime=20221017101445) **Dependent Care FSA**
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-hsa.svg?mtime=20221017101444) **Employer-Supported Health Savings Account**
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-disability.svg?mtime=20221017101443) **Short-Term Disability**
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-retirement-plans.svg?mtime=20221017101442) **Retirement Plans/Company-Matched 401(k)**
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-eap.svg?mtime=20221017101441) **Free Counseling through Employee Assistance Program**
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/benefits-grid_1.jpg?mtime=20221017145429) ![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/benefits-grid_2.jpg?mtime=20221017145440) ![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/benefits-grid_3.jpg?mtime=20221017145436) ![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/benefits-grid_4.jpg?mtime=20221017145720)
## Feel at home, wherever you work.
How, where and when you work is largely up to you.
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-unlimited-vacation.svg?mtime=20221017101440)
**Flexible Time Off**
We trust you to do your work, and encourage you to take time off when you need it. And our managers make sure everyone takes advantage of that policy.
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-breaks.svg?mtime=20221017101439)
**Company-Wide Breaks**
When we shut down, we shut down. Like, everyone. We're constantly exploring new ways to give everyone time away for family, focus and relaxation—from full weeks off to single-day time-outs.
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-workspaces.svg?mtime=20221017101438)
**Modern Workspaces**
We support working remotely across many of our roles and locations. But we also have incredible workspaces around the world, including our headquarters in Lincoln, Nebraska—which has free lunch every day and on-site childcare.
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-flexible-hours.svg?mtime=20221017101434) **Flexible Work Hours**
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-flexible-location.svg?mtime=20221017101435) **Location Flexibility**
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-sabbatical.svg?mtime=20221017101436) **Paid Sabbatical Every Five Years**
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-volunteering.svg?mtime=20221017101437) **Time Off for Volunteering**
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/benefits-grid_5.jpg?mtime=20221017150049) ![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/benefits-grid_6.jpg?mtime=20221017150059) ![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/benefits-grid_7.jpg?mtime=20221017150159) ![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/benefits-grid_8.jpg?mtime=20221017150053)
## Let's get better together.
We give everyone the freedom to test, learn and get better at your work. And we equip you with the tools to do it.
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-professional-development.svg?mtime=20221017101433)
**Professional Development**
Constant improvement is woven into our DNA, and we give employees countless online and in-person resources to grow their skills and their career.
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-erg.svg?mtime=20221017101431)
**Employee Resource Groups**
Part of our commitment to constant improvement is about growing our cultural competency. [Our employee resource groups (ERGs)](https://www.hudl.com/blog/inside-employee-resource-groups-at-hudl) offer Hudl employees an outlet to gather, learn from each other and grow together.
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-feedback.svg?mtime=20221017101428) **Ongoing Performance Feedback**
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-retreats.svg?mtime=20221017101429) **Hudl Company Retreats**
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-annual-feedback.svg?mtime=20221017101430) **Annual Feedback Opportunities**
## Ready to roll?
Let's kick off your career.
[See Open Positions](https://www.hudl.com/jobs/search)

# We've got your back.
Every day at Hudl, you get to help athletes, coaches and teams around the world reach their potential. Not a bad reason to get out of bed. And every day that you do, we'll support you with a comprehensive suite of benefits and perks designed to make you physically, mentally and financially well.
## The core of care.
Our core benefits make sure you're always taken care of.
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-health-insurance.svg?mtime=20221017101450)
**Health Insurance with Free Premiums**
When it comes to your most important needs, don't think twice. We offer competitive health insurance plans, paid premiums for employees, fitness club credits and more.
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-parental-leave.svg?mtime=20221017101449)
**Dedicated Parental Leave**
Your family comes first. And when it grows, we're here for you. Birth parents get up to 14 weeks off, paid. And we provide up to eight weeks off for non-birth parents or parents who adopt or foster.
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-family-planning.svg?mtime=20230322140614)
**Fertility and Family Forming Support**
Everybody's path to family is different. That's why we offer financial support to employees whose journey requires things like preservation, assisted reproduction, adoption or surrogacy.
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-vision.svg?mtime=20221017101448) **Vision Insurance**
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-life-insurance.svg?mtime=20221017101447) **Life Insurance**
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-dental.svg?mtime=20221017101446) **Dental Insurance**
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-fsa.svg?mtime=20221017101445) **Dependent Care FSA**
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-hsa.svg?mtime=20221017101444) **Employer-Supported Health Savings Account**
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-disability.svg?mtime=20221017101443) **Short-Term Disability**
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-retirement-plans.svg?mtime=20221017101442) **Retirement Plans/Company-Matched 401(k)**
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-eap.svg?mtime=20221017101441) **Free Counseling through Employee Assistance Program**

## Feel at home, wherever you work.
How, where and when you work is largely up to you.
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-unlimited-vacation.svg?mtime=20221017101440)
**Flexible Time Off**
We trust you to do your work, and encourage you to take time off when you need it. And our managers make sure everyone takes advantage of that policy.
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-breaks.svg?mtime=20221017101439)
**Company-Wide Breaks**
When we shut down, we shut down. Like, everyone. We're constantly exploring new ways to give everyone time away for family, focus and relaxation—from full weeks off to single-day time-outs.
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-workspaces.svg?mtime=20221017101438)
**Modern Workspaces**
We support working remotely across many of our roles and locations. But we also have incredible workspaces around the world, including our headquarters in Lincoln, Nebraska—which has free lunch every day and on-site childcare.
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-flexible-hours.svg?mtime=20221017101434) **Flexible Work Hours**
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-flexible-location.svg?mtime=20221017101435) **Location Flexibility**
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-sabbatical.svg?mtime=20221017101436) **Paid Sabbatical Every Five Years**
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-volunteering.svg?mtime=20221017101437) **Time Off for Volunteering**

## Let's get better together.
We give everyone the freedom to test, learn and get better at your work. And we equip you with the tools to do it.
![](https://static.hudl.com/craft/icons/benefits/icon-professional-development.svg?mtime=20221017101433)
